parole.testo: Borrowed from Latin oratio, possibly through Polish intermediate oracja (first appears 18th century). Compare Aromanian urãciuni, which is probably inherited (see also the now rare Romanian urăciune, which may be from the same source or may also be an internal derivation from ura).
Borrowed from Late Latin proba, from Latin probō; partly through the intermediate of Polish and Hungarian próba, German Probe.

From Latin summa. The word was probably originally inherited and popular, as evidenced by its appearance (also in an older form somă) among the earliest Romanian texts from the 16th century, and the popular nature of some of its derivatives and related terms.
